Act3-1#1.zh: 报！陈达头目去打史家村时，反而被史进捉住了！现在生死不明。
Act3-1#1.t: Report! When Chief Chen Da attacked Shi Family Village, he was captured by Shi Jin! No one knows if he's alive or dead.

Act3-1#3.zh: 不听我的劝告，果然变成这个下场。
Act3-1#3.t: He wouldn't listen to me, and this is what came of it.

Act3-1#4.zh: 大哥！我们倾巢而出，乘混乱将二哥救出来怎么样？
Act3-1#4.t: Big brother! What if we take everyone down and rescue second brother in the confusion?

Act3-1#5.zh: 笨蛋！连陈达都轻易被史进活捉，我们两个加起来也打不过他呀！
Act3-1#5.t: Fool! Shi Jin took Chen Da alive without breaking a sweat. Even the two of us together couldn't beat him!

Act3-1#6.zh: 那也不能就见死不救啊！当初我们结拜兄弟时，已经发誓『不求同日生，只愿同日死』！如今陈达生死不明，我们怎么能袖手旁观呢！
Act3-1#6.t: But we can't just let him die! When we swore brotherhood we vowed: "Though not born on the same day, we will die on the same day!" Now Chen Da may be dead or alive. How can we stand by and do nothing?

Act3-1#7.zh: 嗯...如今只有这个办法了...贤弟，你有不怕死的胆量吗？
Act3-1#7.t: Hmm... there's only one way now... Brother, do you have the courage to face death?

Act3-1#8.zh: 当然！只要能救陈达出来，我杨春什么地方都敢闯！兄长有何吩咐？
Act3-1#8.t: Of course! If it saves Chen Da, I, Yang Chun, will charge in anywhere! What are your orders, brother?

Act3-1#9.t: Good! Let's go! To Shi Family Village!

Act3-1#10.zh: 朱武，杨春舍命闯史家村！
Act3-1#10.t: Zhu Wu and Yang Chun risk their lives at Shi Family Village!
